headword: {情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}
gloss: sharing information; putting out information; communication

definitions.gloss: sharing information; putting out information; dissemination
definitions.explanation: The act of actively sending out or publishing information to the public or a specific audience. Common in media, marketing, and social media contexts.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I share information on social media.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The local government is actively putting out information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧な{情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{災害時|さいがいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Accurate information sharing becomes especially important during disasters.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (information) and ⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧ (transmission, sending out). A modern buzzword reflecting the importance of proactive communication, especially online.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out information dissemination
- {情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}{力|りょく}: ability to share information effectively
- {情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧: platform for sharing information
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧な{情報発信|じょうほうはっしん}: proactive information sharing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧: public relations, publicity — more formal/organizational
- ⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧: transmission, sending — the base word without ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧
- {周知|しゅうち}: making widely known — focuses on ensuring awareness
